CERTIFICATE OF ORGANIC OPERATION
Operation
Willamette Cultured Foods, Inc.
3300 NW Yeon Ave

Operation ID 40128
Scope
Handler and processor of cultured dairy products, including receipt, fermentation, packaging and storage of certified organic material.

The operation identified above has been inspected in accordance with the USDA National Organic Program (7 CFR Part 205) and, under the equivalency arrangement, the Canada Organic Regime. Certification first granted 01/12/24.

Certified products:

  • Organic Cultured Sour Cream Base, 18% MF
  • Organic Cultured Buttermilk Concentrate
  • Organic Creme Fraiche Base, 36% MF

Subject to satisfactory completion of the annual inspection and to continued conformity with the organic system plan on file, this certification remains valid through 31 December 2027. It does not transfer with a change of ownership and may be suspended or revoked at any time for cause. Verification of current status may be obtained from the certifier at the address above or from the USDA Organic INTEGRITY Database.
